newsitem.title: USA: Boeing, Rockwell begin consent solicitation.
newsitem.headline: Boeing, Rockwell begin consent solicitation.

text.p: The Boeing Co and Rockwell International Corp announced on Wednesday that they have initiated a consent solicitation to holders of $1.6 billion of Rockwell notes.

The solicitation is being conducted to allow Boeing to assume responsibilty for payment of substantially all of Rockwell's debt in connection with its acquisition of the assets of Rockwell's aerospace and defense business.

The solicitations are being made to all holders of record of six issues of Rockwell notes as of 1700 EST/2200 GMT on November 8, 1996. The solicitation period will expire at 1700 EST/2200 GMT, on November 22, 1996.
The six issues are the 7-5/8s due 2/17/98, the 8-7/8s due 9/15/99, the 8-3/8s due 2/15/01, the 6-3/4s due 9/15/02, the 7-7/8s due 2/15/05 and the 6-5/8s of 6/1/05.

Holders who deliver valid consents prior to the expiration period will receive consent fees ranging from $1.50 to $2.50 for each $1,000 principal amount of the notes. The solicitation agent for the transaction is CS First Boston.
